title: Obwesige Obusooka Okumenyebwa mu Jjana
intro: Kuba akafaananyi ng’oyimiridde mu lusuku olw’emirembe egituukiridde, oluweebwa ekitiibwa okusinga ebitonde byonna, ng’olina ensalo emu yokka gy’olina okussaamu ekitiibwa. Okuwuubaala kusuubiza emirembe n’emirembe, okulonda okumu kukyusa buli kimu, era naye okusaasira kuggulawo ekkubo ery’okudda. Ani ayogera okuva ku ntandikwa y’obuntu?
clues: Ntondebwa Allah okuva mu bbumba era nakolebwa n’obwegendereza obw’obwakatonda.
Naweebwa ekitiibwa Allah bwe yalagira ba malayika okunvuunamira.
Nnabeera mu Jjana ne munnange, nga ndi wa ddembe okunyumirwa byonna okuggyako omuti gumu.
Nalimbibwa enduulu ya sitaani eyalayira okubeera omuwabuzi omwesimbu.
Nalya ku muti ogwagaanibwa era ekibikka kyange ne kiggyibwawo olw’ensonyi.
Nayiga ebigambo eby’okwenenya okuva eri Mukama wange, era Allah n’ankyukira mu kusaasira.

trial.label: Okugezesebwa/Ekibaddewo
options: Yagaana okuyingira mu Nsi Entukuvu olw’okutya
Yalya ku muti ogwagaanibwa oluvannyuma lwa Sitaani okuwuubaala
Yawakanya nti ebifaananyi bya bajjajja birina okusinzibwa
trial.answer: Yalya ku muti ogwagaanibwa oluvannyuma lwa Sitaani okuwuubaala

outcome.label: Ebivudemu
options: Allah yanjigiriza ebigambo eby’okwenenya era n’ansonyiwa
Namira ekyennyanja ekinene olw’okuvaawo nga nnyiize
outcome.answer: Allah yanjigiriza ebigambo eby’okwenenya era n’ansonyiwa

arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers." (7:23)
